o.`room_id` = r.`room_id` and u.user_id = o.user_id

and shop_name like concat("%",#{orderVo.shopName})

select count(0) from orders o where 1=1
and o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

select ifnull(sum(pay_money),0) from orders o where 1=1
and o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

select ifnull(sum(refund_money),0) from orders o where 1=1
and o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(pay_money), 0) AS orderAmount, IFNULL(SUM(platform_money), 0) AS platformIncome FROM orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{time}, '%Y-%m-%d')
